name: Wikinote
description: A new tab for discovering articles from Wikipedia, Hacker News, and your own notes.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.wikipedia.org https://en.wikipedia.org https://upload.wikimedia.org https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com https:; img-src 'self' data: https://*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' data: https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com;
